invariants.rationale: The last statement of the method sets renderOffsetDirty to false, so this must hold at method exit.
If parent is non-null, renderOffsetX is assigned to parent.getRenderOffsetX() + offsetX.
If parent is non-null, renderOffsetY is assigned to parent.getRenderOffsetY() + offsetY.
If parent is null, renderOffsetX is assigned to offsetX.
If parent is null, renderOffsetY is assigned to offsetY.
